sentences.text:
The instant appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 has been filed on
behalf of the appellant seeking the following reliefs:
"It is therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court m

ay be pleased to summon and examine the records of the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Delhi, admit the Petition Appeal, amend/modify the impugned order dated 07.05.2024 in MACT No.357/2023 passed by Dr. Ruchi Aggarwal Asrani, Judge, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi and allow claim petition to proceed u/s 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, for compensation of Rs.50,00,000/- with interest @ 18% per annum from date of filing claim petition till realization, with cost of petition, as prayed by appellant, in the claim petition, to the appellants.
Any other order[s]relief[s] which the Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper, in the facts and circumstances of the case be also passed in favour of petitioners and against the respondents."
